english-league-titles.title: Most English league titles
english-league-titles.source: RSSSF England champions (14 Jun 2026); Premier League, 19 May 2026; counted season by season
english-league-titles.note: Top-flight titles, 1888 to 2026. Clubs level on titles are in the order they got there.

premier-league-appearances.title: Most Premier League appearances
premier-league-appearances.source: premierleague.com all-time appearances (read 9 Oct 2026); Opta Analyst, 1 Jun 2026
premier-league-appearances.note: Premier League games only, 1992 to today, on the league’s own count.

premier-league-goals.title: Most Premier League goals
premier-league-goals.source: premierleague.com all-time goals (read 9 Oct 2026); Opta Analyst, 18 May 2026
premier-league-goals.note: Premier League goals only, to the end of 2025-26, on the league’s own count.

england-caps.title: Most England caps (men)
england-caps.source: Englandstats.com, every cap numbered; the FA, 6 Oct 2026; RSSSF
england-caps.note: England men’s caps at the end of the 2026 World Cup. Level players in the order they got there.

manchester-united-top-scorers.title: Manchester United’s top scorers
manchester-united-top-scorers.source: MUFCinfo all players, all goals; Wikipedia records page (26 Aug 2026)
manchester-united-top-scorers.note: All competitions, to the end of 2025-26. Level players in the order they got there.

liverpool-top-scorers.title: Liverpool’s top scorers
liverpool-top-scorers.source: liverpoolfc.com and LFChistory.net, which agree on the top 25
liverpool-top-scorers.note: All competitions, to the end of 2025-26.

arsenal-top-scorers.title: Arsenal’s top scorers
arsenal-top-scorers.source: arsenal.com goalscorers; Wikipedia records page (4 Sep 2026)
arsenal-top-scorers.note: All competitions, to the end of 2025-26. Level players in the order they got there.

chelsea-top-scorers.title: Chelsea’s top scorers
chelsea-top-scorers.source: chelseafc.com all-time record goalscorers (11 May 2026); Wikipedia records page
chelsea-top-scorers.note: All competitions, to the end of 2025-26. Level players in the order they got there.

tottenham-top-scorers.title: Tottenham’s top scorers
tottenham-top-scorers.source: tottenhamhotspur.com all-time top goalscorers and player pages; Wikipedia records page (2 Oct 2026)
tottenham-top-scorers.note: The club’s own count, Charity Shield not included, to the end of 2025-26.

premier-league-points.title: Most Premier League points ever
premier-league-points.source: The 34 final tables on premierleague.com, summed; Wikipedia season pages, 686 club-seasons, no mismatch
premier-league-points.note: Every Premier League season from 1992-93 to 2025-26, added up.

english-top-flight-seasons.title: Most English top-flight seasons
english-top-flight-seasons.source: Counted club by club over all 127 completed seasons; MyFootballFacts (5 Oct 2026)
english-top-flight-seasons.note: Completed top-flight seasons, 1888-89 to 2025-26. Level clubs by who started there first.

world-cup-matches-won.title: Most World Cup matches won
world-cup-matches-won.source: Wikipedia World Cup records, overall team records (6 Oct 2026); Transfermarkt all-time table; all 104 matches of 2026 tallied
world-cup-matches-won.note: World Cup matches won, 1930 to 2026. A shoot-out is a draw. Level nations by all-time points.

premier-league-clean-sheets.title: Most Premier League clean sheets
premier-league-clean-sheets.source: premierleague.com clean sheets, goalkeepers (read 9 Oct 2026); Opta Analyst, 7 Aug 2026
premier-league-clean-sheets.note: Goalkeepers, Premier League only, to the end of 2025-26. Level keepers by fewer games.

champions-league-goals.title: Most Champions League goals
champions-league-goals.source: UEFA statistics feed, tournament phase (read 9 Oct 2026); uefa.com all-time top scorers, 10 Sep 2026; RSSSF, 18 Jun 2026
champions-league-goals.note: UEFA’s count, qualifying left out, to the end of 2025-26. Level players by fewer games.

real-madrid-top-scorers.title: Real Madrid’s all-time top scorers
real-madrid-top-scorers.source: realmadrid.com, each player’s own page (read 9 Oct 2026); Spanish Wikipedia record table; BDFutbol
real-madrid-top-scorers.note: Official matches to the end of 2025-26, by the club’s own count.

la-liga-goals.title: Most La Liga goals
la-liga-goals.source: BDFutbol all-time scorers (read 9 Oct 2026); atleticodemadrid.com; laliga.com for Zarra
la-liga-goals.note: Spanish top division only, to the end of 2025-26, by BDFutbol’s count.

premier-league-goalkeeper-appearances.title: Most Premier League games in goal
premier-league-goalkeeper-appearances.source: premierleague.com appearances, goalkeepers (read 9 Oct 2026); Soccerbase game by game; Transfermarkt
premier-league-goalkeeper-appearances.note: Goalkeepers, Premier League only, to the end of 2025-26.

premier-league-assists.title: Most Premier League assists
premier-league-assists.source: premierleague.com all-time assists (read 9 Oct 2026); Opta Analyst, 24 May 2026
premier-league-assists.note: On the Premier League’s own count, to the end of 2025-26. Level players by fewer games.

spain-caps.title: Most Spain caps (men)
spain-caps.source: RFEF player pages; RSSSF, 14 Mar 2026; Transfermarkt (read 9 Oct 2026)
spain-caps.note: Spain men’s caps at the end of the 2026 World Cup. Level players in the order they got there.
